thread.document:
Executive Summary

This report details the refactoring changes applied to HW3 code using Gemini for assistance. The goal was to enhance the code’s readability, type safety, and Pythonic style while strictly
preserving the existing functionality and flow required for the educational context.



Note: There was no spreadsheet for the deconfliction of Part C, so I didn't realize this was already done. I did check if it was done, but I now see that I missed the post.
